source_metadata.title: INTRYGUE: Induction-Aware Entropy Gating for Reliable RAG Uncertainty Estimation
source_metadata.evaluated_file: INTRYGUE Induction-Aware Entropy Gating for Reliable RAG Uncertainty Estimation - 2603.21607v2.pdf

extraction_limitations: Baseline AUROC matrices in Tables 1-2 were preserved in the SEA artifact but were not atomized cell-by-cell; the atom set prioritizes all reported INTRYGUE cells plus load-bearing baseline comparisons to avoid hundreds of repetitive matrix atoms under the current scalar-result schema.

The ± quantities in AUROC tables are preserved verbatim in quantitative_result.original_result_text because the table captions state only that results are averaged over five runs and do not explicitly label the dispersion statistic.
Several causal-ablation figures report trends graphically without exact numeric values in the text; those findings are represented as qualitative_result atoms rather than estimated from plots.
No external code repository, supplementary file beyond the PDF appendices, or independent replication was used for extraction.
source_inconsistencies: Figure 5 caption says positive entropy Pre-Post values indicate entropy-neuron activations “inflate model confidence,” whereas the surrounding text and mechanism state that these neurons increase predictive entropy and reduce confidence; this appears internally inconsistent and was not normalized away.
